Short Bio#711:8.value: Ahmed Hassan is a 20-year-old medical student who struggles to keep up with the demanding workload of his studies. His daily routine is often unstructured, and although he creates study plans, he finds it difficult to follow them consistently. After long and exhausting days, he tends to procrastinate by spending time on his phone, especially watching videos or scrolling through social media.
